newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: MOTOR CYCLING-KOCINSKI IN PERFECT START DESPITE WEATHER.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR CYCLING-KOCINSKI IN PERFECT START DESPITE WEATHER.

text.p: John Kocinski, riding for his new team Honda, got a perfect start to this year's world superbike championships on Sunday despite some atrocious conditions.
The American finished the first round in Phillip Island in top spot with a one-point lead over Carl Fogarty of Britain.
Kocinski overcame extremely wet and oily conditions to win the opening race, coming home more than 15 seconds ahead of Fogarty.
"I can't think of any worse conditions I've raced in with oil and water on the track but I stayed focused and am pleased to win my first race for Honda," said Kocinski.

The weather cleared for the second race but this time Kocinski came in seventh, a long way behind the winner -- his Honda team mate Aaron Slight of New Zealand, who had fallen in the first race. Fogarty was fourth.
The next round is San Marino on April 20.
